messages.subject_clean: [shinyapps-users] Re: Why do I have to confirm deployment?
messages.body_plain:
The Publish button in RStudio always uses deployApp. It doesn't use deployDoc at all; deployDoc is just a convenient wrapper for deployApp for use at the R console that automates the process finding a document's dependencies.

When publishing content, the Publish button first figures out a list of files to publish; for a Shiny app this is the entire directory less some files known to be unnecessary; for documents it invokes rmarkdown::find_external_resources to discover the .Rmd's dependencies. The user has the opportunity to change the list of files to be deployed; once the user's selections are made, it calls deployApp with the final list of files.

Does that help? If it doesn't, let me know what particular part of the publish process you're interested in and I can elaborate further, or point you to the relevant part of the IDE code (which does mostly live in R for this feature).

Jonathan.

I actually found the solution.. posting here so other Google searchers can see them:

It looks like when you upload your app to shinyapps.io <http://shinyapps.io>, you need to include a line of code that register the app with your account. This is the thing you did with token and secret password to register your RStudio IDE

> shinyapps::setAccountInfo(name='your-account', token='your-token', secret='your-secret')

I personally did this in server.R but I am not sure if anywhere else would be better (global.R maybe?) I am also unsure if library(shinyapps) is better or library(rsconnect) is better.

Then your shinyapp can do things like shinyapps::showUsers(appName = "your app name", server = "shinyapps.io <http://shinyapps.io>") and shinyapps:addAuthorizedUser(email = "youremail", ...) etc. to add users to your app

Beware, when there seems to be a bug where if you attempt to add authorized user when twice (same email), then the app crashes. Also note that showUsers() return a data.frame of user info

Best,
Leon Kim

      leafletProxy("map") %>%
